description: FigJam boards — sticky notes, text, shapes (flowchart, engineering and decorative), sections, reaction stamps and connectors, on one or more pages, previewed as a picture of the board and drawn into a FigJam file by the Graffiticode FigJam plugin. Successor to L0172.

example_prompts.prompt: A retrospective board with Went well, To improve and Action items sections, three stickies in each.
example_prompts.notes: One page holding three `section [ sticky … {} … ] name "…" x … {}` members; stickies spaced 280 apart.

example_prompts.prompt: A flowchart: Start, Fetch data, a Valid? decision, then Save or Report error.
example_prompts.notes: `shape kind ROUNDED_RECTANGLE`/`DIAMOND` members with ids, and `connector from "…" to "…" label "yes" {}`.

example_prompts.prompt: A hub sticky called Idea joined to six stickies around it.
example_prompts.notes: `connector from "hub" to "*" {}` joins the hub to every other node on the page.

example_prompts.prompt: A workshop board with Agenda, Brainstorm and Decisions pages.
example_prompts.notes: Three `page [ … ] name "…" {}` members in the board; pages show as tabs.

example_prompts.prompt: Add a kanban board to my FigJam file https://www.figma.com/board/ABC123/Sprint.
example_prompts.notes: `save-to-figjam "https://www.figma.com/board/ABC123/Sprint"` on its own line before the board; the plugin draws it into that file.
